html.body: Kreb's Cycle: Also known as Tricarboxylic Acid Cycle. Eight enzymes of the catalytic series of well-know organic reactions that collectively oxidize an acetyl group to two CO2 molceules with the concomitant generation of three NADHs, one FADH2, and one GTP.
